text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...As expected of a Classic race.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(So this is the power of those tied to the "Storm,"
is it? However—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Strangely enough... I feel refreshed...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey was so close~.
I hope she gives it her all in the Nippon Derby too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Hmm, longer distances mean you can't just rely on raw speed, so wouldn't that make it even tougher? I'm a bit worried, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey, having returned from the fierce battle,
somehow looks rather satisfied—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...The Classic races really are marvelous, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "The power to forge a new era... I could truly feel that potential within her."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And...
a new desire to look deeper into it
has begun to well up within me.
choice_data_list: I wonder if we can do that in the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. Surely.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Shall we be on our way?
To our next destination—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho, came to an end—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A few days later.
A piece of news raced across the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
S-So your next race really isn't the Japanese Oaks,
but the Japanese Derby... then...?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —...That's right.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: With so many fans expecting revenge for the Oka Sho in the Yushun Himba, why choose the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)...?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Because I want to run in the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Because to me, that's the
coolest look there is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's the only reason.
The rest... I'll show it all in the race!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: "No, no, what's with this...?! Sure, Vodka's strong and all, but suddenly changing course like this is just..."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: Man, taking on the challenge is amazing and all, but honestly, I think I kinda wanted to see her get revenge on Daiwa Scarlet in the Oaks more...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Just entering the Japanese Derby from the Tiara route is super rare, you know. Insane!
If she wins, it'll be a massive feat!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's only if I win, right?
Hmm, I honestly think staying on the Tiara route is totally fine, though...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ……Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Every last one of them, just running their mouths however they please—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
…………I'll blow away all this chirping
with my running, too...!

—Oh.
I thought I heard someone's voice...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, it was you, Vodka-san?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Journey-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Japanese Derby'.
I never thought I'd be able
to run alongside you."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you trying to say it's weird
for me to run the Derby too, Senpai?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...If I have made you uncomfortable,
I sincerely apologize. I never intended to—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...On the contrary.
Your choice looks like a glorious challenge.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes, for example—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Just like Tanino Gimlet-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The 1,600m mile GⅠ, the NHK Mile Cup.
The 2,400m middle-distance GⅠ, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Entering both of these races, held in such close proximity, makes for an extremely brutal rotation.
Commonly known as... the "MC Rotation."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
He was the only one in history to tackle
this NHK Mile Cup rotation after running in the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who ran well in all of them,
and crowned it with a victory in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That was... Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
She is someone you revere,
and someone who has greatly influenced your running and aesthetics.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I could tell right away.
Your challenge for the Japanese Derby was meant to carry on her aesthetic.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I have someone too... after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Someone whose running style they want to inherit,
just like Gimlet-san is to you."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Journey-senpai...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I shall look forward to it.
To your challenge, which seeks to bring about historic devastation.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let us compete with all our might
at the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You'd better be ready for this, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna get seriously, ridiculously stronger than I am now,
and make it to the Derby!!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That's...... heheh—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks to Vodka-san, it seems the Japanese Derby is drawing even more attention than usual this year.
choice_data_list: To be honest, I was surprised too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In the recent Oka Sho, Vodka had suffered
a narrow defeat against Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fierce duel between the two, far ahead of the pack,
was a thrilling battle that showed their sheer potential,
and it remains fresh in our memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I thought she might become a formidable rival for Dream Journey
if their paths ever crossed in the future, but..."
choice_data_list: I didn't think it would happen so soon—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —To think you'd come so quickly for me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...We need to take countermeasures immediately.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Especially on Tokyo's homestretch, going head-to-head with that closing kick is something we should avoid—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Was it just my imagination?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For just a moment back there, it seemed like Dream Journey...
looked awfully happy—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: “—That is how I wish my own journey to be.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "A journey where we face countless 'storms' and uncover the brilliance of history... something like that."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: ...You're really happy right now, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...What made you think that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Depending on Vodka's result in the Nippon Derby,
the racing world, its history, and its common sense
would be drastically changed. Shattered completely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is truly...
the 'storm' that Dream Journey sought.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Splendid.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: You truly watch over me very closely, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Look at me.
Look at the sky stretching out beyond our path.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...All the more fitting to accompany me on my journey.
choice_data_list: ...Let's look for a way to overcome the "storm."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
With the time we have left, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Whether that approaching presence will truly
become a "storm"—
that is something only the heavens know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The traveler prepares, and presses forward.
To the next destination... the Festival of Champions—
